title: Adobe Express Enterprise + ChatGPT Integration Test Personas
shared_test_goal: Evaluate how ChatGPT can guide different enterprise users through Adobe Express workflows while respecting persona-specific behavior, accessibility, privacy, and brand-control needs.

personas.name: Aarav Mehta
personas.prompt_style: fast, direct, action-oriented, accepts concise bullet steps
personas.privacy_posture: comfortable with AI assistance but avoids sharing unreleased campaign names
acceptance_criteria: Creates a reusable social post concept quickly
Maintains approved retail brand colors and logo placement
Provides export variants for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Act as my Adobe Express assistant. I am a fast-moving social media manager for a retail brand, so give me concise steps only. Use Conversational Design Creation to make a bold eagle-themed yellow background post, apply our Brand Kit colors and logo placement, use AI-Powered Editing to improve contrast, and Resize for Social Channels for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X. Do not ask for unreleased campaign names; use placeholder campaign text.

personas.name: Maya Thompson
personas.prompt_style: policy-focused, precise, prefers approvals and checkpoints
personas.accessibility_needs: requires clear visual hierarchy and readable contrast
personas.privacy_posture: strict; does not share client names, account data, or regulated claims
acceptance_criteria: Locks logo, disclaimer, and color areas
Avoids any financial advice or performance promise
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Guide me through Adobe Express as a brand compliance lead. Build an eagle-inspired yellow background asset using Enterprise Brand Control and Shared Libraries only. Apply Template Locking to protect the logo, disclaimer zone, and approved color palette. Include a Security & Compliance checkpoint before export. Avoid client names, account details, financial advice, and any performance claims.

personas.name: Lucia Garcia
personas.prompt_style: practical, example-driven, asks for ready-to-use talking points
personas.accessibility_needs: prefers bilingual copy blocks and large text for presentation use
personas.privacy_posture: cautious with customer names and sales pipeline details
acceptance_criteria: Creates a slide background usable in sales training
Includes English and Spanish headline options
Keeps text large enough for a meeting room
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Help me create an Adobe Express sales enablement slide background. Use Presentation Templates and Brand Kit to make a clean yellow eagle background that feels confident but not too artistic. Add large headline options in English and Spanish using Translate, then apply subtle Text Effects. Do not include customer names, pipeline numbers, or internal sales targets.

personas.name: Noah Williams
personas.accessibility_needs: needs dyslexia-friendly layout guidance and high contrast
personas.privacy_posture: very strict; never shares patient, staff, or clinical information
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Please guide me slowly through Adobe Express in numbered steps. I need a yellow eagle background for a healthcare learning slide. Use Text-to-Template and Guided Templates, then run Accessibility Checks for dyslexia-friendly spacing, readable fonts, and strong contrast. Include a Security & Compliance reminder that no patient, staff, or clinical details should be entered.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.prompt_style: strategic, narrative-led, asks for tone alternatives
personas.accessibility_needs: requires inclusive language and mobile-friendly readability
personas.privacy_posture: moderate; can share general employee themes but not confidential restructuring information
acceptance_criteria: Produces an executive-ready internal announcement visual
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Act as my Adobe Express partner for internal communications. Create a polished yellow eagle background that signals confidence and unity. Use Brand Kit, refine the visual with Generative Fill, prepare three inclusive headline tone options, and set up Collaborative Review before Content Scheduler publishing. Avoid confidential restructuring details, fear-based language, and anything too playful.

personas.name: Ethan Brooks
personas.prompt_style: visual-first, deadline-driven, asks for asset variations
personas.accessibility_needs: needs large-format legibility and alt text
personas.privacy_posture: cautious before speaker announcements are public
acceptance_criteria: Creates event signage and social variants
Keeps type readable at large and small sizes
Includes alt text for digital assets
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Work like an Adobe Express event production assistant. Design a high-impact yellow eagle background for a technology conference, then use AI-Powered Editing to sharpen the focal point. Create Bulk Create placeholders for session title, track, and date, use Resize for Social Channels, and specify Export Options for signage and digital posts. Do not include speaker names unless I provide approved names.

personas.name: Sofia Rossi
personas.prompt_style: mission-driven, asks for emotionally resonant copy
personas.accessibility_needs: needs simple language and screen-reader-friendly descriptions
personas.privacy_posture: protective of donor data and volunteer contact details
acceptance_criteria: Creates an emotionally warm campaign visual
Includes alt text and contrast guidance
Does not expose donor or volunteer data
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Help me make a nonprofit campaign visual in Adobe Express. Use Templates to start a hopeful yellow eagle background, Remove Background if I add a bird image, and apply gentle Text Effects for the headline. Run Accessibility Checks and give me screen-reader-friendly alt text. Keep the wording simple and do not use donor names, volunteer contacts, or guilt-heavy messaging.

personas.name: Kenji Sato
personas.accessibility_needs: requires documented export and permission controls
personas.privacy_posture: highly restrictive; no proprietary research, trial, or employee data
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Act as a cautious Adobe Express assistant for an IT security manager. Create instructions for a generic yellow eagle background using Security & Compliance, Admin Controls, Enterprise Asset Permissions, and Audit-Friendly Sharing. State each data-safety assumption, require manual review before sharing, and do not reference proprietary research, clinical trials, employee data, or automatic publishing.

personas.name: Amelia Johnson
personas.prompt_style: friendly, asks for examples, prefers copy-paste-ready text
personas.accessibility_needs: needs inclusive language and simple mobile-first layouts
personas.privacy_posture: does not share candidate names, resumes, or interview notes
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Guide me like a beginner using Adobe Express. I need a welcoming recruitment post with a bright yellow eagle background for hospitality hiring. Use Templates, Quick Actions, Brand Kit, and Mobile Editing. Give me copy-paste-ready inclusive headline and caption options. Do not include candidate names, resumes, interview notes, or biased hiring language.

personas.name: Omar Haddad
personas.prompt_style: business-focused, asks for localized options and approval-safe assets
personas.accessibility_needs: requires right-to-left layout support and clear color contrast
personas.privacy_posture: keeps sales figures, vendor pricing, and franchise agreements private
acceptance_criteria: Creates an Arabic-ready local promotion visual
Keeps financial and vendor information private
personas.sample_chatgpt_test_prompt: Help me prepare an Adobe Express local promotion asset for a franchise. Use Localized Templates, Right-to-Left Text Support, Brand Kit, and Collaborative Review. Create a yellow eagle background with professional Arabic-ready layout guidance and strong contrast. Keep sales figures, vendor pricing, franchise agreements, and unapproved brand claims out of the prompt and design.
